triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. Every current CHECKS entry has an existing oracle.* registry mutant with an isolating maintained negative-control leaf. The removed callbackDecided check was redundant with referenceRefusal/referenceKind; it is not counted as a kill or as a live missing guard. The source runner and sealed comparison results were read; current registry cases preserve the independently meaningful comparisons.

S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. Every current CHECKS entry has an existing oracle.* registry mutant with an isolating maintained negative-control leaf. The removed callbackDecided check was redundant with referenceRefusal/referenceKind; it is not counted as a kill or as a live missing guard. The source runner and sealed comparison results were read; current registry cases preserve the independently meaningful comparisons.

S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.

triage.rationale: S5. The maintained fault-oracle controls independently alter returned values, whole views, both sequence probes, setup grants, apply-window locations/prefixes, reference decisions and exit inventory. The fault-sweep retains all report/takeover scenarios including the five callback baselines and hidden recovery. The round-9 M1-M5 decisions correspond to setupGrant, returned/recoveryAnswer, applySequence/outcomePrefix, referenceUnnamed and nextRefusal. Their current state-owner locations and complete-decision comparisons preserve the obligation; ordinary product test counts alone do not close it.
